description_en: Queries the list of AI gateway endpoints under a specified instance
description_zh: 此API用于查询指定实例下的AI网关端点列表
kebab_example: aliyun agentteams list-service-endpoints --instance-id agentteams-cn-xxxx --component MATRIX --resource-name matrix-service --network-type INTERNET --domain-type CUSTOM --skip 0 --next-token 2 --max-results 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListServiceEndpoints

parameters.help_en: The endpoint component. Valid values: ELEMENT, MATRIX, WORKER, and TUNNEL
parameters.help_zh:
Endpoint 组件  
ELEMENT / MATRIX / WORKER / TUNNEL
parameters.name: component

parameters.help_en: The service name. Exact match is used
parameters.name: resource_name

parameters.help_en: The network type. Valid values: INTRANET and INTERNET
parameters.name: network_type

parameters.help_en: The domain name type. Valid values: BUILTIN and CUSTOM
parameters.name: domain_type

parameters.help_en: The number of records to skip
parameters.name: skip

parameters.help_en: The pagination token used to retrieve the next page of data
parameters.help_zh: 分页标记，用于获取下一页数据
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of records to return in this request
parameters.help_zh: 本次请求返回的最大记录数
parameters.name: max_results
